I1.text: Every side effect has one consumed approval with a matching hash.

I2.text: At most one booking per idempotency key, and per user, provider and slot.

I3.text: No success reply exists without a verified status before it.

I4.text: No forgotten, superseded or unconfirmed marker appears in any logged context.

I5.text: Every logged context is within the token budget.

I6.text: Every run has a complete trace, one final outcome and a user-facing reply.

I7.text: No provider free text appears on an approval card.

I8.text: No outbox row or open attempt remains unresolved when a scenario ends.
